about.title: One digital ecosystem, several services
paras: Massar is the digital environment connected with school education in Morocco. Schools and education administrations use it to follow a student's academic pathway and to manage information such as enrolment, grades, attendance, results and orientation.

But "Massar" is not a single page or a single login. Different users have different spaces: Massar Moutamadris for students, Massar Waliye for parents and guardians, and Massar Moudaris for education professionals. Choosing the right space is the first step to avoiding confusion.
points: Waliye: the parent and guardian space

steps.title: Four checks before asking for help
steps.lead: Do not start by trying random passwords or sending your details to someone who promises to fix your account. Work through a clear sequence.

items.title: Identify the service
items.text: Are you trying Massar Moutamadris, Massar Waliye or Massar Moudaris? Each uses a different account.

items.title: Check your details
items.text: Review the username and password, your keyboard language, and any accidental spaces.

items.title: Read the error
items.text: Note the exact message. It may point to wrong details, an inactive account or a temporary service issue.

items.title: Use the official channel
items.text: If the problem continues, contact your school or the relevant administration. Never share your password.

split.title: Ongoing grades are not the same as final results

colA.title: Checking grades
colA.text: Grades shown during the year reflect different assessments and activities, and they may be updated in stages.
items: A subject grade may not appear immediately after a test
Publishing timing is controlled by the school

colB.title: Understanding results
colB.text: Final or examination results follow a different publishing process and may be announced through specific official channels.
items: Not every result is available in every space
Official results require verification at the source
A delay does not necessarily mean your account is broken

security.title: Your Massar Code and password are private
security.text: The Massar Code is an identifier linked to a student within the education system. It may be requested for administrative procedures, but it should never be posted publicly or sent to an unofficial website.
items: Never share your password or one-time codes.
Check the website address before entering credentials.
Avoid unofficial Massar Code generators or recovery sites.
If in doubt, contact your school directly.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions about Massar
faq.lead: Short answers, with a detailed guide for each question.

items.q: Is Massar Services the official Ministry website?
items.a: No. Massar Services is an independent information website, not affiliated with Morocco's Ministry of National Education. We direct readers to official platforms when needed.

items.q: What is the difference between Moutamadris and Waliye?
items.a: Massar Moutamadris is the student space. Massar Waliye is the parent and guardian space for following available school information about their child.

items.q: Where can I find my Massar grades?
items.a: Grades are normally shown in the space linked to your account: Moutamadris for a student, or Waliye for a parent or guardian, after the school publishes them.

items.q: Why are my grades or results missing?
items.a: The school may not have published them yet, or the data may still be updating. Confirm you are in the correct account, then contact the school if the problem continues.

items.q: I forgot my password. Can you recover it?
items.a: No. We cannot access your account or change your password. Use the recovery process available on the official platform, or contact your school.

items.q: Should I share my password with someone helping me?
items.a: No. Never share your password or one-time code. Use official channels only, and remember that legitimate staff do not need your password.
